title: Prove a real pre-split machine still authenticates
acceptance_criteria: A pre-split fixture at 0600 with the full current key set is exercised end to end with the real binary: factory auth works, board sync works, permissions survive, the migration is idempotent, and a factory-free file is untouched. The user-visible experience during migration is described. No credential-shaped literals in tracked files. go test ./... green.
